title: Large Language Models for Multi-Lingual Equivalent Mutant Detection: An Extended Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2607.00511v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mutation testing is a powerful technique for ensuring software quality. However, the presence of equivalent mutants introduces unnecessary costs and biases, limiting its practical effectiveness. Although numerous equivalent mutant detection (EMD) methods have been proposed, they often face distinct challenges: pure-code analysis methods can be limited by their reliance on specific compiler infrastructures, while existing machine-learning approaches remain constrained by scarce training data and limited generalization to unseen mutants. Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable performance across diverse code-related tasks by better capturing program semantics. Yet their potential for EMD remains largely unexplored, particularly in the multi-lingual context. translated_title: 面向多语言等价变异体检测的大语言模型：一项扩展实证研究
translated_abstract: 变异测试是一种保障软件质量的强大技术。然而，等价变异体的存在会带来不必要的成本和偏差，限制了其实际效果。尽管学界已提出众多等价变异体检测（EMD）方法，但它们往往面临各自独特的挑战：纯代码分析方法可能受限于对特定编译器基础设施的依赖，而现有机器学习方法则受制于训练数据稀缺以及对未见变异体泛化能力有限的问题。大语言模型（LLMs）近期通过更好地捕捉程序语义，在各类代码相关任务中展现出卓越性能。然而，它们在EMD方面的潜力在很大程度上仍未被探索，尤其是在多语言场景下。本文开展了首个关于LLM用于EMD的全面实证研究，使用3,302个Java变异体对和1,088个C变异体对，与最先进的（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文首个针对大语言模型在多语言（Java与C）等价变异体检测上的全面实证研究，利用3,302个Java和1,088个C变异体对进行基准评估，验证了LLM克服传统纯代码分析和机器学习方法局限的潜力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first comprehensive empirical study of large language models for multi-lingual equivalent mutant detection, benchmarking on 3,302 Java and 1,088 C mutant pairs to validate LLMs' potential in overcoming the limitations of pure-code analysis and machine-learning-based methods.
